tools.name: qualitative_get_capabilities
tools.description: Describes the Qualitative Analysis service: what it does, how authentication and credits work, the input limits and the background-job model (start, then poll). Call it once to orient yourself before the first analysis, or when the user asks what the service can do. No account needed. It lists neith

tools.name: qualitative_list_presets
tools.description: Lists the current analysis presets (qualitative methods): preset id and version, title, description, required and optional input slots, the analysis steps and the report types each preset can produce. Call it before quoting or starting an analysis to choose a `preset_id` and valid `selected_reports`

tools.name: qualitative_get_pricing
tools.description: Returns the public price list: the value of one credit in USD and how the package price is tiered by word count. Use it for general pricing questions that have no concrete inputs. For the exact price of a specific analysis use qualitative_quote_analysis. No account needed. It does not change an acco

tools.name: qualitative_quote_analysis
tools.description: Prices one complete analysis package from word counts alone and returns the price in credits and USD, the model and reasoning effort that would be used, what is included and which reports are available. Read-only: nothing is stored and nothing is charged. Send counts only (`input_word_counts`, optio

tools.name: qualitative_get_account
tools.description: Returns the account behind the sign-in (OAuth or API key): credit balance, whether a credit reconciliation blocks new charges, and the key's prefix and scopes. Requires sign-in (OAuth connector or API key). Use it to check the balance before starting an analysis or after a payment_required error. It

tools.name: qualitative_list_runs
tools.description: Lists the user's analyses (runs), newest first: id, title, status, preset, package status and price. Requires sign-in (OAuth connector or API key) with the runs:read scope. Use it to find a `run_id` when the user refers to earlier work. For the progress or details of one analysis use qualitative_get

tools.name: qualitative_get_run
tools.description: Returns the current state of one analysis: status, package (price, refunds, last error, `retry_available`, `refund_on_cancel`), steps, progress, ready deliverables, `web_url`, `action_required` and `next_poll_after_seconds`. Requires sign-in (OAuth connector or API key) with the runs:read scope. Ana

tools.name: qualitative_list_deliverables
tools.description: Lists the outputs of one analysis with their status and available formats: first the main report (type `main_report`, id `step:<run_id>:<step_key>`, format md), which every finished analysis includes without buying anything extra, then the reports, codebook, evidence matrix and other deliverables. tools.name: qualitative_get_deliverable
tools.description: Fetches one deliverable of an analysis. In the formats md, txt and json the text is returned in `content`, up to 200000 characters. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "qualitative_quote_analysis" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: qualitative_get_capabilities, qualitative_quote_analysis, qualitative_get_deliverable, qualitative_start_analysis · Private data: qualitative_quote_analysis, qualitative_get_account, qualitative_list_runs, qualitative_get_run, qualitative_list_deliverables, qualitative_get_deliverable, qualitative_start_analysis, qualitative_retry_analysis, qualitative_cancel_analysis · Public sink: qualitative_quote_analysis, qualitative_start_analysis · Destructive: qualitative_get_run, qualitative_list_deliverables, qualitative_get_deliverable, qualitative_retry_analysis, qualitative_cancel_analysis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: qualitative_get_capabilities, qualitative_quote_analysis, qualitative_get_deliverable, qualitative_start_analysis · Private data: qualitative_quote_analysis, qualitative_get_account, qualitative_list_runs, qualitative_get_run, qualitative_list_deliverables, qualitative_get_deliverable, qualitative_start_analysis, qualitative_retry_analysis, qualitative_cancel_analysis · Public sink: qualitative_quote_analysis, qualitative_start_analysis · Destructive: qualitative_get_run, qualitative_list_deliverables, qualitative_get_deliverable, qualitative_retry_analysis, qualitative_cancel_analysis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
